NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA平台和全栈软硬件协同构建数据中心级AI基础设施，赋能全行业AI应用。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Building data center-scale AI infrastructure through CUDA platform and full-stack hardware-software co-design to power AI across industries.
concrete_bets: CUDA software stack and domain-specific libraries
extreme co-design of chips, networking, systems, and software

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 打造智能云与智能边缘全栈AI平台，以Copilot和Agent赋能企业生产力。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Build a full-stack intelligent cloud and edge AI platform empowering enterprise productivity via Copilot and agents.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform spanning data and AI capabilities
Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents for productivity transformation
Integrated AI-driven security, compliance, and identity solutions

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Ontology为核心，通过AIP把生成式AI与LLM接入Gotham和Foundry，让AI进入每个决策。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embed generative AI and LLMs into Gotham and Foundry via AIP, bringing AI to every decision through the Ontology.
concrete_bets: AIP platform integrating open-source, self-hosted, and commercial LLMs
Ontology-driven activation of AI in operations
AI deployment across commercial and government sectors via Gotham and Foundry

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI驱动社交体验，通过Meta AI和AI眼镜将智能助手融入产品家族与下一代计算平台
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: AI powers social experiences, with Meta AI and AI glasses embedding assistants across apps and next-gen computing.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及LLM侵蚀信任、ChatGPT账号攻破、训练偏好声明、青少年保护、模型规范与前沿模型失准监测等安全治理议题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers LLM trust erosion, ChatGPT account exploits, training preferences, teen protections, Model Spec, and frontier misalignment monitoring.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖推理模型构建、文本分类、循环Transformer、水印检测、AI文本检测器、LLM评审新颖性及持续学习等模型研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers reasoning model building, text classification, looped transformers, watermarking, AI text detection, novelty judging, continual learning.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: HuggingFace发布Nemotron、Granite、Mistral Large 4、语音与决策开源模型、LFM3多模态及Trainium适配等开源生态动态。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: HuggingFace releases Nemotron, Granite, Mistral Large 4, speech/decision models, LFM3 multimodal, and Trainium compatibility.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 包括律所尽调、信用卡企业ROI、ServiceNow合作以及Google在结核筛查、母婴超声、湿实验室与地球AI的行业应用。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Includes legal diligence, credit-card ROI, ServiceNow partnership, and Google AI in TB screening, maternal ultrasound, wet labs, Earth AI.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及uv.lock依赖调试、datasette-llm发布、NES模拟器、API额度、自主Fable多智能体世界、headless MCP、Deep Review与技术文档分析等开发实践。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers uv.lock debugging, datasette-llm release, NES emulator, API credits, autonomous Fable agents, headless MCP, Deep Review, and tech doc analysis.
